headline: Judge dismisses antitrust cases against Google's AI Overviews feature
body: A US judge dismissed antitrust lawsuits filed by Chegg and Penske against Google over its AI Overviews search feature, removing a significant legal threat to the company's AI integration strategy. For healthcare AI, this ruling signals that courts may not restrict how large technology platforms embed generative AI into existing products, even when those products compete with specialized services. Healthcare organizations evaluating AI vendors should monitor how this precedent shapes vendor liability and integration practices. The dismissal also comes as Google advances its Gemini 4 model capabilities, positioning itself more competitively in enterprise AI adoption where healthcare systems are increasingly deploying Gen AI for clinical documentation and decision support. This legal clarity may accelerate healthcare's adoption of integrated AI tools from major cloud vendors rather than specialist healthcare AI companies.
